learningObjectives: Explain the challenges of managing shared application state.
Use Context API concepts to share state across components.
Choose suitable state management approaches for different application needs.

activities.title: State Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Click each state location to explore whether the data should be local or shared.

content.concept: State can remain local to one component or be shared across multiple components when several parts of an application depend on the same data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: State used by one component or a small isolated UI area.
State lifted to a common parent so multiple child components can access it through props.
Shared values provided through React Context to components within a provider.
State managed through a dedicated application-wide state solution when broader coordination is required.

activities.title: Context Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the main parts of a Context API setup.

content.concept: A Context setup commonly includes a context object, a Provider that supplies a value, and consuming components that read the shared value.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Creates the Context object used to share a value.
Makes the context value available to components in its subtree.
The data or functions supplied through the context.
Hook used by a functional component to read the current context value.
Component that accesses and uses the shared context.

activities.title: State Strategy Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the most appropriate state strategy for each scenario.

content.concept: State should be placed according to its scope: local state for isolated UI behavior, lifted state for related components, and Context or other shared solutions when many components need the same data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: A form field used by one component → Local state
A form field used by one component → Global state
config.answer: A form field used by one component → Local state

activities.title: Context Provider Builder
activities.instruction: Build the flow for sharing a value through React Context.

content.concept: A Provider makes a context value available to its descendant components, which can access the value without receiving it through every intermediate component as a prop.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
